Bengal Government Revokes Award from BJP MP Ananta Maharaj

The West Bengal government has withdrawn the Banga Bibhushan award from BJP MP Ananta Maharaj. This action follows remarks he made about Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose, which were described as 'war criminal' comments. Maharaj, also known as Nagendra Roy, faces six FIRs related to these remarks. He has since issued an apology.
